FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Manager, Brewed Awakening Coffeehouse, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@brewedawakening.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Brewed Awakening Coffeehouse operates as a cozy retail establishment focused on providing high-quality coffee and tea beverages, alongside a selection of light meals and snacks. Our operations prioritize a warm and inviting atmosphere for our customers, ensuring all staff are well-trained in food safety and customer service. We maintain a strictly non-alcoholic menu, eliminating liquor liability concerns, and we do not offer live entertainment, which helps us keep noise levels down and creates a tranquil environment for patrons. Our space is carefully curated to remain within the preferred size limits, and we enforce stringent fire safety protocols with clear emergency exits and regularly maintained fire extinguishers. Our facility upholds all local health, safety, and zoning regulations to ensure compliance and minimize risks. Additionally, we manage our inventory effectively to reduce waste and spoilage, ensuring fresh offerings for our customers. As part of our commitment to community engagement, we offer seasonal menu adjustments while adhering to our operational guidelines.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not exceed the maximum total floor area of 7,500 square feet and maintains a seating capacity of no more than 150 patrons. Additionally, we confirm that no alcohol service is provided on the premises, and there is no live entertainment or amplified music allowed.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2021, we experienced a minor water leak due to a malfunctioning coffee machine. The incident resulted in a property damage loss of $1,200. The damage has been fully repaired and the status is closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Electronic cash drawer, Class B, UL Listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security watchperson services during peak hours.
